objective: Configure and verify main and screen integration through the original bootloader.
primary_profile: Unmodified stock boot2.4.0.24 @0x410000 → unmodified stock main2.4.0.24 @0x438000 on one declared virtual G2 temple
scope_notes: Starts at bootloader reset vector; actual Boot ROM execution is not claimed.
Normal stock boot path is required; patched boot handoff and forced success/PC/return are excluded.
Existing2.3/Faceclaw evidence stays historical; applicability is documented, not inferred from2.4.
No physical glasses access/writes, Astra, external posting, or whole-fidelity25 criteria activation.

criteria.description: Pin provenance, SHA, vector, and loading address of original bootloader/main.
Execute actual initialization code on M55 from original boot reset vector without bypassing branches.
Configure boot-required code-region protection and peripheral/ROM contracts from evidence, and block unknowns.
Verify original image selection/validation, required metadata, and path to handoff.
Continuously execute original handoff → main reset on the same virtual board and verify VTOR/MSP/PC and state lineage.
Connect RTOS/UI → original rendering → completed 576×288 frame in that main and inspect it directly.
Verify two identical cold inputs and rejection of corrupted inputs/unsupported boundaries.
Complete reproduction commands, pinned manifest, comparison/final audit, and cleanup of task-specific artifacts.

progress_rule: Equal weight, verified conditions only. All8 required; no partial credit from test count.
